verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only built-in views (Kanban, table) and the ability to configure personalized dashboards. Separately, it documents an API, MCP and BI export for data access. None of this documents a UI extension or SDK that lets a designer build custom views or dashboard widgets rendered natively inside Wrike. Configuring built-in dashboards and exporting data to BI tools are adjacent features or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product
